summary.zh: 把重复搬运交给飞行单位，再围绕覆盖、能源和吞吐重新规划。
summary.en: Delegate hauling to flying units, then plan around coverage, energy and throughput.

rules.zh: 玩家设置供给点、需求点与运输设施，让飞行单位搬运物品。覆盖或航线、充能和装卸能力限制效率；运输队列与缺货提示需要扩容的位置。
rules.en: Players configure supply, demand and transport facilities so flying units move items. Coverage or routes, energy and handling capacity limit throughput; queues and shortages show where to expand.

decisions.zh: 飞行可以绕开地形，但长距离与频繁小批量可能拖低效率。
decisions.en: Flight bypasses terrain, but distance and small frequent loads can reduce efficiency.

decisions.zh: 集中枢纽易管理，分散节点更接近消费者。
decisions.en: Central hubs are easy to manage; distributed nodes sit closer to consumers.

effect.zh: 载量增大适合大宗运输，载量小会放大往返成本。
effect.en: Larger payloads favor bulk transport; small payloads amplify round-trip cost.

effect.zh: 充能点稀疏会让节点位置比直线距离更关键。
effect.en: Sparse charging or fuel points can matter more than straight-line distance.

contrast.zh: 前者是覆盖区域内的请求网络；后者围绕港口之间的指定往返路线。
contrast.en: Factorio uses requests within network coverage; Satisfactory uses designated trips between ports.

combination.zh: 为雪山研究站运送物资：玩家可修昂贵的道路，也可建设受天气窗口限制的无人机港。
combination.en: Supply mountain research stations by choosing expensive roads or drone ports constrained by weather windows.

setup.zh: 两座工坊需要零件，唯一运输机总在远处往返，近处也开始缺货。
setup.en: Two workshops need parts; the only drone keeps making long trips while the nearby workshop runs dry.

action.zh: 你增加一个中转库存，调整需求量，让运输机成批补货。
action.en: Add a buffer stock and adjust requests so the drone delivers useful batches.

result.zh: 小批量往返减少，但新增节点也需要能源与维护。
result.en: Tiny repeated trips decrease, though the added node still needs energy and upkeep.

next.zh: 看队列与缺货记录，再决定添运力还是改节点位置。
next.en: Inspect queues and shortages before adding capacity or moving nodes.

firstStep.zh: 用地图节点、固定航程时间和一架带充电状态的运输机，先不用自由飞行寻路。
firstStep.en: Use map nodes, fixed travel times and one drone with a charge state; omit free-flight pathfinding initially.

pitfall.zh: 大量自主单位、碰撞和动态航线容易带来性能问题，先验证订单分配规则。
pitfall.en: Large autonomous fleets, collisions and dynamic routes can create performance problems; test dispatch rules first.

test.zh: 在远近需求同时出现时，玩家是否能通过改库存或线路减少缺货等待？
test.en: With near and far requests active, can players reduce shortages by changing buffers or routes?
